summary: Four Fitness Parks cost 24 Stone and 40 Planks in total, and the Sawmill, Quarry and Warehouse are already built. Add a Lumberjacks' Base, keep the Sawmill and Quarry staffed, and build Parks as materials arrive; 90 days is generous.

build_order.note: Seven villagers and one house; settle them.
Optional 120 Fruit: tend the 24 wild Apple and Fig Trees and plant more.
Somewhere to keep the Fruit stock.

pitfalls: Bridges are in the build list; check whether stone or trees sit across water before relying on them.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
